dct_description_sm: In this study, individual measurements of annual, or within-season growth were determined from tag-recaptured Arctic charr and examined in relation to summer sea surface temperatures and within-season capture timing. Based on laboratory studies, it was hypothesized that individuals experiencing warmer marine habitats would evidence increased individual growth rates in comparison to conspecifics using cooler marine habitats under the assumption that food was not a limiting factor.
dct_title_s: Marine temperature use and growth of Arctic charr
